annotations.title: Register as a referrer at a company

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in. Use when the user says they work at a company and want to refer candidates. Registers the signed-in user as a referrer for the company and sends a verification link to their work email; the email domain must belong to that company. They become a referrer only after clicking the link.

company_slug.description: Company slug from search_companies or get_company (the company the user works at).

note.description: Optional note for the techjobs.vn team, e.g. which teams or roles the user can refer for.

work_email.description: The user's own work email at that company (not Gmail/Yahoo). The verification link is sent there.

name: register_as_referrer

registrations_url.description: Where the user sees their referrer registrations on techjobs.vn.

title: Register as a referrer at a company
